definitions.recall5_and10: Micro coverage of independently annotated evidence units in top5/top10, plus mean per question. All spans or an admitted alternative must be covered.
definitions.mrr_at10: Mean reciprocal rank of first individual top10 candidate fully covering any required unit, zero when absent.
definitions.by_category: Requested/evaluated/unresolved/errors, rates, denominators and grouped bootstrap estimates visible separately.

limits: Pure synthetic metric tests; no runtime API, embedding, LLM or final dataset called.
One fully covered unit does not validate an incomplete multi-unit question; all-required-evidence metric remains zero.
